entries.german: König Wenzel von Böhmen erklärt, den Brüdern Kaspar und Gundakar von Starhemberg wegen seiner und Heinrichs von Rosenberg Gefangenhaltung in Wildberg nicht feind zu sein.
entries.english: King Wenzel of Bohemian declares that he is not hostile toward the brothers Kaspar and Gundakar von Starhemberg regarding his and Heinrich von Rosenberg's detention in Wildberg.

entries.summary:
Johann Markgraf von Brandenburg ersucht seinen Schwager Herzog Albrecht von Österreich, den Brüdern Caspar und Gundakar von Starhemberg, die Gefangenhaltung seines Bruders des Königs Wenzla und des Heinrich von Rosenberg in Wildberg nicht entgelten zu lassen.

Siegel: Papier-Siegel rückwärtig aufgedrückt.
entries.german:
Dem hochgebornen fursten hern Albrechten herczogen zu Ostereich zu Steyr zu Kernden vnd zu Chrayn etc. vnsrem lieben swager embieten wir Johannes von Gots gnaden markgraue zu Brandemburg vnd zu Lusicz vnd herczog zu Gorlicz vnsre fruntschaft grus vnd willige beheglichkeyt zu allen czeiten. Hochgeborner fürste, lieber swager, wir begern von ewer liebe vnd bitten euch mit fleizze vmb dy behaltnusse, so die edlen Caspar vnd Gundacker gebrüder von Starkenberg den allerdurluchtigsten fürsten vnd hern hern Wenczlawen Romischen kunige zu allen czeiten merer des Reichs vnd kunige zu Behem vnsern gnedigen hern vnd lieben bruder mit dem edlen Heinreich von Rosenberg in irr vesten Wiltperg getan haben, das ir yn das durch vnsern willen vergebet vnd in mit worten vnd mit werken nicht dester feinter seyt noch nyemant von iren wegen vnd gebt in ouch des ewern brieff für euch vnd ewer erben vnd für die ewern in vnd yren erben, wan wir ins vnd yren erben für vns vnd vnser erben vergeben haben mit vnsern briuen vnd worten, wann wir wol vernomen haben, das sy euch harte dorvmb besorgen. Do van getrawen wir ewr liebe wol, das ir vns des nicht versaget, doran tut ir vns besunderlich fruntschaft vnd liebe. Mit vrkund diez briues versigelt mit vnserm vfdrukten insigel, geben zum Pyesk des nehsten Dinstages noch send Bartholomens tage des heiligen czwelfboten noch Christi geburt dreyczehenhundert dornoch in dem virvndnewczigsten iaren.
Ad mandatum domini ducis Conradus etc.
entries.english:
We, Johann, by the grace of God Margrave of Brandenburg and Lusatia and Duke of Görlitz, send our greetings and willing goodwill at all times to the high-born prince Lord Albrecht, Duke of Austria, Styria, Carinthia, and Carniola, our dear brother-in-law. High-born prince, dear brother-in-law, we earnestly ask your favor concerning the detention at their fortress of Wildberg of the most illustrious prince and lord, Lord Wenceslaus, King of the Romans, ever-augmenter of the Empire, and King of Bohemia, our gracious lord and beloved brother, where the noble Heinrich von Rosenberg was also present, which the noble brothers Caspar and Gundakar von Starhemberg caused. For our sake, forgive them for this, and do not on that account be more hostile to them in word or deed, nor to anyone acting on their behalf. Also give them your letter, for you and your heirs and those under you, and for them and their heirs, just as we have forgiven them and their heirs on behalf of ourselves and our heirs by our letters and words, since we have learned that they are greatly apprehensive about this. Therefore, we trust your love will not refuse us this; in doing so you will show us particular friendship and affection. In witness of this letter, sealed with our impressed seal, given at Pisek on the Tuesday following the feast of Saint Bartholomew the Apostle, in the year 1394 after the birth of Christ.
By order of the lord duke, Conrad, etc.

entries.summary: König Wenzla ersucht die Herren, Ritter und Knechte in Österreich, den Brüdern Caspar und Gundakar von Starhemberg seine und des Heinrich von Rosenberg Gefangenhaltung in Wildberg nicht entgelten zu lassen.
entries.german: Wir Wenczlaw von Gotes gnaden Romischer kunig, zu allen czeiten merer des Reichs vnd kunig zu Beheim embieten allen herren rittern vnd knechten, die do siczen zu Osterich oder wo sie siczen in des hochgebornen Albrechtes herczoges zu Osterich zu Steyern vnd zu Kerrenden etc. vnsers liben swager vnd fursten landen, vnser gnade vnd alles gut. Wir begeren von euch vmb die behaltnuss, so die edlen Caspar vnd Gundachker gebrüder von Starchenberg den edlen Heinrichen von Rosemberg mit vns in irer vesten Wiltperg getan haben, das ir jn das durch vnsern willen vorgebt vnd in mit wortten vnd mit werken in keinerleyweis dester veynter dorumb seit noch nymant von iren wegen vnd besorget sie des mit ewerm brief fur euch vnd ewer erben, sie vnd ire erben, wann wir yns mit vnserm prief vnd wortten vorgeben haben. Douon getrawen wir euch wol, ir vorczeicht vns sein nicht vnd gewert vns in den sachen. Geben zu Piesk vnder vnserm angedrucktem insigele nach Crists geburt dreyczenhundert jare, dornach in dem virvndnewnczigistem jare des nechsten Dinstags noch sand Bartholomes tage, vnsrer reiche des Behmischen in dem XXXII vnd des Romischen in dem XIX jaren. Ad mandatum domini regis Johannes Gamynensis electus cancellarius.
entries.english:
We, Wenceslaus, by the grace of God King of the Romans, ever-augmenter of the Empire, and King of Bohemia, send our grace and every good to all lords, knights, and squires who reside in Austria, or wherever they reside in the lands of the high-born Albrecht, Duke of Austria, Styria, and Carinthia, our beloved brother-in-law and prince. We ask you to forgive them for detaining me at their fortress of Wildberg, where the noble Heinrich von Rosenberg was also present. For our sake, forgive them for this, do not on that account be hostile to them in any way, by word or deed, nor to anyone acting on their behalf. Secure them in this by your letter, for yourselves and your heirs, and for them and their heirs, since we have forgiven them by our letter and word. We trust you will not refuse us this and will grant our request in these matters. Given at Pisek under our impressed seal, on the Tuesday following the feast of Saint Bartholomew, in the year 1394 after the birth of Christ, in the 32nd year of our Bohemian reign and the 19th of our Roman reign.
By order of the lord king, Johannes, elected chancellor of Gamynensis.

entries.english:
We, Johann, by the grace of God Margrave of Brandenburg and Lusatia and Duke of Görlitz, send greetings and particular friendship to all lords, knights, and squires who reside in Austria, or wherever they reside in the lands of the high-born prince Lord Albrecht, Duke of Austria, Styria, Carinthia, and Carniola, our beloved brother-in-law. We ask you to forgive them for detaining at their fortress of Wildberg the most illustrious prince and lord, Lord Wenceslaus, King of the Romans and of Bohemia, our gracious lord and beloved brother, where the noble Heinrich von Rosenberg was also present. For our sake, forgive them for this, do not on that account be hostile to them in any way, by word or deed, nor to anyone acting on their behalf. Secure them in this by your letter, for yourselves and your heirs, and for them and their heirs, since our aforesaid lord and brother the king and we have forgiven them by our letters and words. We trust you will not refuse us this and will grant our request in these matters. Sealed with our impressed seal, given at Pisek on the Tuesday following the feast of Saint Bartholomew the Apostle, in the year 1394 after the birth of Christ.
By order of the lord duke, etc. Simon, etc.
